tags.name: AuthenticationService
tags.description:
AuthenticationService exposes authentication commands and progress queries.
The host must authorize access to each transaction independently of its ID.

tags.name: PaymentService
tags.description:
PaymentService manages payments for the authenticated client.
Ownership comes from authentication, never from a caller-supplied client ID.

tags.name: VirtualCardService
tags.description:
VirtualCardService manages cards owned by the authenticated client.
Mutations may return before provider processing finishes.
Idempotency keys are scoped to client and method: identical retries return the
original operation; reuse with a different payload is rejected.

tags.name: SupportService
tags.description: SupportService exposes public customer support contact information.

tags.name: KYCService
tags.description: KYCService collects the authenticated client's identity data.

tags.name: NotificationService
tags.description: NotificationService manages the authenticated client's Telegram notifications.

get.summary:
GetAuthPolicy lists caller-visible intents and configured authentication choices.
This is a static description, not a guarantee of current method availability.

post.summary: CreateTransaction starts a tenant-bound authentication transaction for a configured intent.

get.summary: GetTransaction reads progress without returning a session credential.

post.summary:
CompleteCallback dispatches host-parsed callback input to the stored method.
This is not a provider's raw redirect URI; proof and correlation are verified
by the callback-capable driver before any evidence is accepted.

parameters.name: challengeId
parameters.description: Method selection comes from this challenge, not from callback input.

post.summary: StartMethod begins a selected method, optionally creating a challenge.
VerifyMethod verifies a direct proof or completes a pending challenge.

get.summary: ListBalances returns the client's wallet assets.
ListPayments returns payment history, newest first by creation time and ID.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Zero selects the server default of 20.

post.summary: RequestCryptoDeposit creates deposit instructions without creating a payment.
Deposit creates a funding request; creation does not credit the wallet.

get.summary: GetPayment returns an owned payment, including available deposit instructions.
ListCards returns the client's cards in stable ID order.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Zero selects the server default of 20.

post.summary: IssueCard creates an issuance payment charged to the client's USD wallet.

get.summary: GetTariff publicly returns only this service's configured card pricing.
GetCard returns an owned card with available live metadata, balance and requisites.

post.summary: CloseCard requests closure; poll GetCard until its state resolves.
TopUpCard creates a card funding payment charged to the client's USD wallet.

get.summary: GetTariff publicly returns only this service's configured payment settings.
GetSupport returns the configured Telegram support account link.

put.summary: SaveKYC replaces collected data without starting or granting verification.

get.summary: GetCurrentIssue restores an active issuance after a reload or lost response.
GetIssue returns an issuance owned by the authenticated client.

post.summary: ResolveFunding records an operator decision for an unknown funding transfer.
ReconcileFunds records the evidenced net provider charge for support reconciliation.
ResolveIssue records an operator decision for an unknown issuance.

get.summary: GetKYCLevel returns only the caller's server-owned verification level.
GetTopUp returns an order owned by the authenticated client.
GetCurrentTopUp restores the active top-up for an owned card.

post.summary: GetTopUpQuote returns the client commission for the requested card credit.

get.summary: GetNotificationSettings reads persisted preferences and Telegram connection readiness.

put.summary: UpdateNotificationSettings saves the shared promo and sending preference.

post.summary: CompleteTelegramConnection links the verified Telegram identity to the current user.
StartTelegramConnection requests verified identity and bot messaging consent.

get.summary: ListCardOperations reads actual provider transactions for an owned card.

session.description: Present when finalization issues a session for this intent.

authorization.v1.AuthenticationResult.description: AuthenticationResult is present only after the application finalizes the flow.

input.description: Host-parsed driver-specific callback proof; never log this object.

intent.description: An existing user is derived from trusted authentication context, never input.

input.description:
Driver-specific JSON decoded and validated for this method and operation.
Use an empty object when the driver requires no input.

challengeId.description: Omit for direct verification. When present, must match the stored attempt challenge.

input.description: Driver-specific proof; never log this object.

authorization.v1.Challenge.description: Challenge identifies a pending attempt without exposing its private state.

result.description: Absent while further authentication or finalization is required.

intents.description: Sorted by intent name. Empty when no configured intent is visible.

authorization.v1.Intent.description:
Intent identifies an account lifecycle flow, independently of authentication methods.
Declaring an intent does not imply that its application workflow is implemented.

authorization.v1.IntentPolicy.description: IntentPolicy describes one caller-visible configured intent.

token.description: Sensitive bearer credential; never log or return in transaction reads.

authorization.v1.IssuedSession.description: IssuedSession contains a newly issued credential and its validity interval.

providerId.description: Empty for methods without a provider.

authorization.v1.MethodSelection.description: MethodSelection identifies one policy option within a requirement scope.

authorization.v1.PendingMethod.description: PendingMethod allows clients to resume a started method without private driver state.

provider.description: Empty for methods without a provider. Set only on method leaves.

authorization.v1.PolicyRequirement.description:
PolicyRequirement is a public requirement tree. Each node has exactly one
nonempty shape: any, all, or method. Groups preserve their configured IDs.
Descendants inherit the nearest nonempty ID as their MethodSelection scope.
Provider alternatives are represented as any children of method leaves.
An all group requires every child, but does not impose an execution order.

authorization.v1.Principal.description: Principal identifies the verified subject after successful finalization.

challenge.description: Absent for methods that do not create a challenge.

redirectUrl.description: Empty for methods that do not redirect the client.

attemptId.description: Required reference for the following Verify or Callback request.

availableMethods.description:
Options from the remaining policy that are currently available to this user.
This list does not express whether the options are alternatives or cumulative.

policySatisfied.description: Policy satisfaction alone does not imply user resolution or finalization.

authorization.v1.Transaction.description: Transaction is a public progress view without credentials or verified evidence.

result.description: Absent while further authentication or finalization is required.

google.protobuf.NullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

atlas.common.v1.Money.description:
Money contains an exact major-denomination decimal string and its currency.
Values never pass through floating point or currency-scale conversion.

atlas.payment.v1.Balance.description:
Balance is a client's virtual wallet asset, separate from card balances.
Currently each client has one USD asset; amounts are USD decimal values.

atlas.payment.v1.CryptoDepositOptions.description:
CryptoDepositOptions selects the network for the amount's currency.
The server checks supported currency/network combinations.

memo.description: Absent when the network does not require a tag or memo.

atlas.payment.v1.CryptoRequisite.description: CryptoRequisite identifies the destination for a crypto deposit.

idempotencyKey.description:
Reusing a key with the same request returns the original result.
Reusing it with a different request is rejected; scope is client and method.

amount.description: External payment amount; conversion into the USD wallet is server-owned.

expiresAt.description: Absent when the provider does not declare an expiration.

atlas.payment.v1.DepositRequisite.description: DepositRequisite contains exactly one set of funding instructions.

nextPageToken.description: Empty when there are no further results.

amount.description: External deposit amount, pending card quote, or actual settled card charge.

fee.description: Customer fee included in amount, in the same currency.

creditedAmount.description: Amount credited to the USD wallet or card; absent until determined.

cardId.description: Present for card operations once the card is identified.

requisite.description: Present for deposits once funding instructions are available.

reservedAmount.description: Outstanding wallet reservation for a card operation; absent for deposits.

releasedAmount.description: Wallet funds released from the reservation; absent for deposits.

atlas.payment.v1.Payment.description: Payment is a customer-visible operation, without internal provider costs.

atlas.payment.v1.PaymentStatus.description: PaymentStatus describes the customer-visible processing outcome.

atlas.payment.v1.PaymentType.description: PaymentType identifies the customer operation shown in payment history.

atlas.payment.v1.SBPDepositOptions.description: SBPDepositOptions selects SBP funding in RUB.

atlas.payment.v1.SBPRequisite.description: SBPRequisite directs the payer to an SBP payment page.

balance.description:
Provider-reported card funds, separate from the virtual wallet.
Absent when unavailable; absence does not mean a zero balance.

atlas.card.v1.Card.description: Card contains customer-visible metadata without PAN or CVV.

atlas.card.v1.CardFee.description:
CardFee uses USD decimal amounts and exact decimal percentage points.
Omitted components mean zero. The fee is max(minimal, fixed + percent * amount / 100), rounded upward to a cent.

atlas.card.v1.CardStatus.description: CardStatus is the normalized customer-visible card state.

atlas.card.v1.CardTariffCategory.description: CardTariffCategory describes a configurable card type keyed by its stable string ID.

requisites.description: Absent when unavailable. Sensitive: never persist, log or cache.

currency.description: All fixed/minimum fees are decimal amounts of this currency (USD).

cardTypeId.description: Application offering identifier, not a provider identifier.

expectedPrice.description: Customer-confirmed quote in USD decimal values. Reject a changed tariff before reserving.

issue.description: Poll GetIssue until the issuance resolves.

payment.description: Reserved for the separate payment history projection.

amount.description: Requested card credit in the card's currency; the server determines wallet charge and fees.

expectedCommission.description: Confirmed commission in USD decimal values; omitted values are rejected before reservation.

deposit.description: CRYPTO and SBP currently contain unconfigured placeholders.

minimalAmount.description: Omitted bounds are unspecified. Amounts are decimal values of the payment currency.

atlas.payment.v1.PaymentMethodTariff.description:
PaymentMethodTariff describes inclusive deposit amount limits, independently of fees.
Its presence does not enable a payment method.

atlas.card.v1.CardTopUpLimits.description: CardTopUpLimits uses inclusive USD decimal bounds. Omitted bounds are unspecified.

telegramUrl.description: Empty when Telegram support is not configured.

atlas.kyc.v1.KYCData.description: KYCData contains sensitive collected identity data. Never log this message.

atlas.kyc.v1.KYCLevel.description: KYCLevel is local verification, not provider KYC status.

issuingCountry.description:
ISO 3166-1 country enum. String encoding preserves the original API and stored payloads.
Source: https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/iso3166.tab (2026-09-29).

expiryDate.description: Empty when the document has no expiry.

atlas.kyc.v1.Passport.description: Passport contains document details, without scans.

atlas.card.v1.CardIssue.description: CardIssue exposes the frozen price and current issuance outcome.

atlas.card.v1.CardIssueStatus.description: CardIssueStatus describes progress without exposing provider identifiers.

chargedAmount.description: Net amount consumed by this issuance as a decimal string in its funding currency.

evidence.description: SHA-256 digest of operator-retained provider evidence.
SHA-256 digest of operator-retained provider evidence.
SHA-256 digest of operator-retained provider evidence.

atlas.card.v1.CardPalette.description: CardPalette contains solid card colors, never arbitrary CSS.

atlas.card.v1.CardIssueStage.description: CardIssueStage identifies the current or failed step in the issuance journey.

atlas.card.v1.CardIssueStep.description: CardIssueStep is one ordered milestone; absent timestamps are not inferred.

atlas.card.v1.CardIssueStepStatus.description: CardIssueStepStatus describes an individual customer-visible step.

atlas.card.v1.CardRequisites.description: CardRequisites contains stored payment details for an owned card.

atlas.card.v1.CardTopUp.description: CardTopUp contains safe order progress and the confirmed client quote.

atlas.card.v1.CardTopUpStage.description: CardTopUpStage identifies the current or failed milestone.

atlas.card.v1.CardTopUpStatus.description: CardTopUpStatus describes the persisted top-up outcome.

atlas.card.v1.CardTopUpStep.description: CardTopUpStep is one ordered persisted milestone.

atlas.card.v1.CardBillingAddress.description: CardBillingAddress contains the stable checkout address for a card.

id.description: Opaque row identity; not an Atlas wallet payment ID.

transactionTime.description: Original provider timestamp. No timezone is inferred when absent.

atlas.card.v1.CardOperation.description: CardOperation is a read-only observation of a provider card transaction.

atlas.card.v1.CardOperationStatus.description: CardOperationStatus identifies the provider's observed processing state.

atlas.card.v1.CardOperationType.description: CardOperationType identifies the observed operation kind.
